title.value: Balancing Profit, Risk, and Sustainability for Portfolio Management
title.justification: The title clearly encapsulates the main themes of the paper, focusing on balancing profit, risk, and sustainability in portfolio management.
title.quote: Balancing Profit, Risk, and Sustainability for Portfolio Management.

extractions.description: The paper explores stock portfolio optimization using reinforcement learning, focusing on a novel utility function that considers profit, risk, and sustainability. The paper introduces a system that evaluates financial returns, risk (through the Sharpe ratio), and sustainability (through ESG scores) in portfolio management.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The integration of sustainability through ESG scores in portfolio optimization makes sustainability a central theme of the paper.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: ...environmental, social, and governance score (ESG) representing sustainability...

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with financial strategies through portfolio optimization, focusing on ESG, which aligns with sustainable finance.
primary_category.quote: ...incorporating risk and sustainability criteria in the utility function, we improve on the state-of-the-art in reinforcement learning for portfolio optimization...

secondary_categories.justification: The paper focuses primarily on financial strategies related to sustainability rather than any direct environmental application.
secondary_categories.quote: Not applicable to other environmental domains but focused on financial portfolio optimization and strategies.

primary_sub_category.value: Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) and Disclosures
primary_sub_category.justification: The paper emphasizes ESG scores as a measure of sustainability within the portfolio optimization process.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...the environmental, social, and governance (ESG) score is a set of criteria that measure a company’s operations for sustainability...

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No other sub-categories beyond ESG and Sustainable Finance are directly addressed in this paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The paper concentrates on using ESG scores within financial portfolio management; other sub-categories are not relevant.

applications.value: Incorporating ESG in portfolio optimization using reinforcement learning to manage and balance risk, profit, and sustainability.
applications.justification: The paper applies ESG scores specifically in portfolio optimization processes, integrating sustainability criteria.
applications.quote: ...including sustainability – in a novel utility function using the Sharpe ratio and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) score, respectively.

new_primary_category.justification: A new category is not warranted as the paper comfortably fits into the existing category of Sustainable Finance.
new_primary_category.quote: The focus on ESG within financial strategies places it firmly within Sustainable Finance.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category needs to be established, as the paper's work fits well under ESG analytics.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The use of ESG scores in financial models aligns with existing sub-categories.
